features: Original base19 plus weekly5 plus4 EASE scalar features: score, full observed candidate percentile, user unobserved, item unobserved
fit_target: Full-universe top5_count80 before shortlist; numeric item ID ties
training_groups: Same positive-and-negative groups as original v3
success_rule: At least +0.01 absolute top5_count80 MAP on main evaluation and nonnegative later delta; show paired-user95percent intervals, no promise of Kaggle gain
diagnostics: Both all80 and top5count80; additive per-slice AP credit for seen/unseen candidates using fixed full-truth denominator;5000 paired-user bootstrap
selection: One fixed refit; no tuning, mixtures, retrieval expansion or score-based feature selection
caveat: Repeatedly explored overlapping periods; bootstrap conditional on fixed models, not selection-adjusted; unseen means no >30percent historical interaction for this user-item pair.
standalone_diagnostic: EASE raw score on unchanged v3 candidate pool and fallback; no extra fit or selection
factorization: Binary historical>30percent interactions; lambda500 fixed; source feature builder separate authorized3snapshots

feature_protocol.fit_universe: compact historically observed users/items only; no future-only IDs
feature_protocol.formula: P=(X.T X+500I)^-1; B=-P/diag(P)[None,:]; diag(B)=0; score=X B
feature_protocol.repeats: retained; diagonal0 is reconstruction constraint, not a seen-item exclusion
feature_protocol.percentile: full eligible observed item scores; top1 bottom0, numeric ID ties, singleitem=>1
feature_protocol.cold: if either entity unseen, score/percentile0; flags independently identify user/item
feature_protocol.labels: forecast labels not loaded or used

fixture.meaning: closed form equals independent per-target constrained ridge solve

source_protocol.threshold: MAX single raw fragment clipped beforecut >30% full airing
